items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: They had Benny Goodman, Teddy Wilson, and Milt Harry Hinton, Shelly Mann, / Edison. Lockjaw was there.

ctx.x: Were you with a group? Did you take a group?
No I didn't take a group but a group went. They had Benny Goodman, Teddy Wilson, and Milt Harry Hinton, Shelly Mann, / Edison. Lockjaw was there.
Oh. Was Gus Johnson on that one?
